correctness.rationale: The proof derives the rank-one incidence edit \(C\), its squared blocks \(P=CC^{\mathsf T}\) and \(Q=C^{\mathsf T}C\), and their universal three-dimensional image spaces. In deletion, \(P^2=ww^{\mathsf T}\), \(C^{\mathsf T}w=0\), and the dual identity imply \(A^5=0\) with \(\operatorname{rank}(A^4)=2\); exact ranks at times one, two and three prove sharpness and all extinction counts. In insertion, the irreducible cubic \(t^3+t+1\) on both image spaces proves the seven-order square and the period-one, seven, fourteen orbit counts. Rank-nullity for \(A^2\) establishes entry times and fiber sizes. Full Fano enumeration and algebraic matrix checks at \(q=2,4,8\) corroborate, rather than substitute for, the universal proof.

value.rationale: One deleted versus one inserted incidence on canonical sparse graph families changes every orbit from global extinction at sharp time five to precisely five nontrivial periodic orbits (one seven-cycle and four fourteen-cycles) with entry by two. This uniform construction works for all even-order projective planes, with basin populations depending on their intrinsic binary 2-rank. The contrast has structural dynamics motivation and is neither a reparametrized textbook rank nor an arbitrary small graph census.
